question: The 15th Pravasi Bhartiya Diwas (2019) was organised at:
solution:
The correct answer is __**Varanasi**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• The 15th Pravasi Bharatiya Divas (PBD) was held from **21st to 23rd January 2019** in Varanasi, Uttar Pradesh.
 
• The theme for the 2019 event was **"Role of Indian Diaspora in building a New India."**
 
• **Prime Minister Narendra Modi** inaugurated the event and **held discussions with the Indian diaspora** on various issues.
 
• Varanasi, one of the oldest living cities in the world, was chosen to showcase the rich cultural heritage and the development taking place in India.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Pravasi Bharatiya Divas (PBD)**

 
 
• PBD is celebrated once every two years to mark the contribution of the Overseas Indian community to the development of India.
 
• The convention provides a platform for the Indian diaspora to engage with the government and people of the land of their ancestors.
 
• The event is aimed at strengthening the engagement of the overseas Indian community with the Government of India and reconnecting them with their roots.
 
• The date, January 9, was chosen to commemorate the return of **Mahatma Gandhi** from South Africa to India in 1915, which led to the start of India's freedom struggle.
 
 
 
• **Varanasi**
 
 
• Varanasi, also known as Kashi or Benares, is a city on the banks of the river Ganges in Uttar Pradesh, India.
 
• It is one of the seven sacred cities (Sapta Puri) in Hinduism and Jainism, and played an important role in the development of Buddhism.
 
• Varanasi is famous for its ghats, the steps leading down to the river, which are used for bathing, rituals, and religious ceremonies.
 
• The city is also known for its silk weaving, producing beautiful Banarasi sarees that are highly valued across India.
